english.title: Depart on flight to outside UK from place other than customs and excise airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), departed on a flight to

(A)_[a place]_
(B)_[an area]_

outside the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE OR AREA..), from a place in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE..), which was a place other than a customs and excise airport, without the permission of the Commissioners of Customs and Excise
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21(3)(a) and (6) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
save as permitted
by the commissioners
depart on a flight to a place outside UK
from a place inside the UK
other than a customs and excise airport

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 21(4) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.provides that this offence shall not apply in relation to an aircraft flying from or to a place or area outside the United Kingdom to or from a place in the United Kingdom which is required by or under an enactment relating to air navigation, or is compelled by accident, stress of weather or other unavoidable cause, to land at a place other than a customs and excise airport.
